about: Wrong or failed analyses reported by product consumers. Captured with dj-party's `cargo run --example capture_analysis_case`. `open` cases must still fail; flip to `fixed` when the analysis is corrected so they gate as regressions. `private` audio records features only and is not run.

cases.note: A creator-described 90 BPM trumpet loop analyzes as 63 BPM, so BPM Sync against a 90 BPM deck lands outside the ±16% tempo range and reports limited.

audio.attribution: sorohanro, "solo-trumpet-06" (Freesound 77711), CC BY 3.0, via librosa/data; decoded to mono 48 kHz 16-bit

expected.why: The loop holds ~3 s of rubato, syncopated trumpet (8 notes, ~92 BPM by onset regression) and then a tail. That is under two bars of evidence: beat-path support is flat across 55-200 BPM, and the eighth-note tatum (~187 BPM) is as well explained by 63 (x3) as by 94 (x2). No reliable tempo, so BPM Sync is unavailable instead of syncing at a 1.42 ratio. Creator-described tempo: 90 BPM.
